data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best overall password manager.

It's particularly good for teams that need to share passwords securely, manage employee access, and avoid losing access to company accounts when someone leaves.

There are a few strong alternatives, though, depending on your budget and how much administration you need.

## Best options compared

![1Password: Password Manager | Apps | Godly](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9Onad3ZmM68M7l5dTIbPMn43a-YB12X_e9tFS-w_jdjYbB1mwCcSBgDwHjfxiov3sFv56iK_BYB0DBDy1ElBpKTj_x8BM6wjwBy4mijsixFzsgcbh4l6IAVcN_W3xEYaPv3HJbWtjoYtl68hPIh1Q4uMTSZR5QKnTsp4CKPumigoRyeUfSzM6z8piMAIIqVa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Easy for non-technical employees
- Strong admin controls and employee offboarding
- Security monitoring with Watchtower

**Approx. C\$29.95/month for up to 10 people** with Teams Starter Pack, billed annually.

Best if simplicity and employee adoption matter.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source core
- Shared collections and team management
- Audit and event logs
- Good security features for the price

**US\$4/user/month** for Teams, billed annually.

Best if you want strong functionality without spending much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administration**

- Detailed access controls
- Shared team folders
- Delegated administration
- Strong compliance-oriented features

**From approximately C\$3/user/month** for Business Starter, billed annually.

Best if access management and compliance are priorities.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass — Best privacy-focused alternative**

- End-to-end encrypted vaults
- Secure sharing
- Strong privacy-oriented ecosystem
- Good option for smaller teams

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Pricing is indicative, based on published 2026 pricing, and may change. Currency and billing terms differ. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your situation | Best choice |
|--------|--------|
| 3–10 employees, want simplicity | 1Password |
| Tight budget | Bitwarden |
| Need detailed admin controls | Keeper |
| Privacy is top priority | Proton Pass |


Since you're in Canada, 1Password has an additional advantage: it's a Toronto-based company with a Canadian data-hosting option. That's useful if Canadian data residency matters to your business. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Three questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right business plan, rather than have you pay for features you don't need.

1. **How many people?** Roughly 2–5, 6–10, 11–25, or more?
2. **What devices?** Windows, Mac, iPhone/Android, or a mixture?
3. **What will you share?** Primarily website logins and business accounts, or also server credentials, API keys, Wi-Fi passwords and other sensitive information?

With those answers, I can narrow it down to one recommendation and the most cost-effective plan.
